content: {"reasoning":"The missing-authorization denial remains after a medical-necessity appeal, and this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. No incorrect claim data or requested information provides a valid rework path. CO-197 assigns the denied balance to contractual responsibility; the deductible and coinsurance figures alone do not establish patient liability, so with no secondary payer or remaining supported recovery path, the balance is uncollectible.","action":"write_off"}
